title: Startup Registration for State & Centre
h1: Startup Recognition Support: DPIIT and Haryana
description: Understand current startup-recognition criteria and separate central, state and tax routes. Rapid supports evidence, narrative and query-response preparation.
metaTitle: DPIIT & Haryana Startup Recognition Support | Rapid
introHtml:
Make your startup-recognition application explain the business clearly. Rapid helps organise the enterprise records, innovation narrative and supporting evidence, then supports preparation and factual query responses.

For a founder, the useful question is which recognition route fits the business and what it can support. Central DPIIT recognition, a Haryana registration and a separate benefit application should be planned as distinct steps.

sections.title: What is DPIIT startup recognition?
sections.html:
DPIIT recognition identifies an eligible startup under the central framework. It is not the same as incorporating a company. The official Startup India page directs recognition applications through the National Single Window System and sets out eligibility. DPIIT recognition.

An application should explain the actual innovation or improvement, business potential and supporting evidence. A recently incorporated entity is not automatically recognised.

sections.title: What do the current criteria say?
sections.html:
The official page reflects the February 2026 revision:

Criterion Published position
Entity Private company, registered partnership, LLP or cooperative society.
Age Up to 10 years; up to 20 for the DeepTech category.
Turnover Below ₹200 crore; ₹300 crore for DeepTech, under the stated criteria.
Business Innovation/improvement and employment or wealth-creation potential; not splitting/reconstruction of an existing business.

DeepTech status has its own evidence requirements; it is not a label a founder should assume from working with technology. Official recognition application and criteria.

sections.title: Recognition, tax benefits and funding are different
sections.html:
Objective What to examine
DPIIT recognition Central eligibility and application evidence.
Haryana startup registration or support Current state route and its separate conditions.
Tax relief The specific tax provision and separate eligibility/application.
Grant, investment or loan The programme or provider's own selection and terms.

Recognition does not automatically award funding or a tax exemption. Startup India presents recognition and the 80-IAC process separately. State-specific eligibility must be checked for the named programme rather than inferred from the central certificate.

sections.title: What preparation can strengthen
sections.html:
A clear business explanation

Describe the problem, solution and what is different or improved. A manufacturing innovation can be explained through process or product evidence without exaggerated technology claims.

Evidence behind the narrative

Connect the application with product material, demonstrations, customer validation or other available records. Distinguish completed progress from future plans.

A practical next-step plan

Identify what you want recognition to support and which separate application comes next. This keeps expectations and effort aligned.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid reviews the proposed recognition route, organises the document checklist and helps structure the factual business narrative. We prepare supporting material and factual query responses while the founder confirms its accuracy. The applicant submits through their own official account; Rapid does not act as a DPIIT-appointed registration agent.

The company owns its claims and documents. DPIIT or the relevant state body makes the recognition decision. Tax opinions and formal certifications remain with the responsible professionals.

sections.title: Documents to prepare
sections.html: Bring incorporation/registration records, ownership and authorised-contact details, a concise business explanation, product/process evidence, available turnover information and any earlier application. For an existing business, explain its history and relationship with other entities clearly.

sections.title: How the assignment works
sections.html:
1. Identify the route and eligibility questions

Review the entity, age, activity and recognition objective.

2. Organise evidence and narrative

Rapid helps make the business explanation understandable and supported by the records available.

3. Support the applicant's submission and queries

The applicant makes the official submission. Rapid helps organise supporting records and factual responses to queries.

4. Identify separate benefit applications

After the recognition decision, examine any tax, state-support or funding requirement on its own terms.

sections.title: Cost and timing
sections.html: Rapid's preparation fee is quoted separately from any official or third-party charges. The official application route should be used for the current fee position. Time depends on evidence readiness and the reviewing body's process; a fixed recognition date or funding result is not promised.

sections.title: Questions founders ask
sections.html:
Is a new company enough to qualify? No. It must meet the recognition criteria, including the business-related requirements.

Can an established business apply? Review its age, constitution, history and innovation against the current definition.

Does recognition guarantee tax exemption? No. The relevant tax route has separate requirements.

Can our CA help with the application? Yes. Financial and entity records can be coordinated with your existing adviser.

Tell us what the business does, when it was incorporated and why you want recognition. An expert consultant from Rapid will call you to understand the requirement and explain the proposed work, fee and next steps.

title: Import and Export Code Certificate
h1: Importer Exporter Code (IEC) Application Support
description: Understand Importer Exporter Code documents, official fees and updates. Rapid coordinates IEC preparation for Haryana businesses.
metaTitle: IEC Application & Update Support | Rapid Consulting
introHtml:
Prepare your business for an import or export requirement with a clear IEC record. Rapid coordinates the entity information, supporting documents and agreed application work so the code matches the business that will trade.

Start before a shipment depends on a missing or outdated record. If you already hold an IEC, the work may concern an update or correction rather than a new code.

sections.title: What is an IEC?
sections.html:
The Importer Exporter Code is administered by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT). It identifies the entity for the applicable foreign-trade requirements. The code should be distinguished from a product permission, customs clearance or a foreign buyer's approval.

DGFT's current user manual explains the application process, bank details, supporting documents and payment. Official IEC manual.

sections.title: New application, update or product permission?
sections.html:
Requirement What the work addresses
New IEC Entity and bank information for the code application.
Existing IEC with changed details Correcting or updating the registered information.
Annual confirmation/update Keeping the IEC record current under DGFT requirements.
Restricted or regulated goods Separate product or trade permissions, where applicable.

If your plan involves food, examine the FSSAI requirement alongside IEC. A code alone does not make every food import permissible.

sections.title: Why organise the record before the transaction?
sections.html:
Keep the trading entity consistent

The contract, invoice, bank account and application should identify the intended business correctly. Resolve differences in names or constitution before relying on the code.

Avoid unnecessary duplicate work

Check for an existing IEC and its status before treating the enquiry as a first application.

Identify the other shipment requirements

Use the product and destination/origin details to identify where specialist customs, product or trade advice is needed. IEC support is one part of that preparation.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid prepares the record checklist, coordinates the entity and bank evidence, and supports the agreed application or update. We track queries and help organise corrections based on the applicant's confirmed facts.

The applicant controls and authorises its official account and declarations. DGFT issues or updates the code. Customs clearance, product approvals and logistics need their own responsible providers and scope.

sections.title: Documents to prepare
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Entity constitution and PAN-linked details Identifies the business applying.
Address evidence Supports the premises information.
Bank details and supporting proof Connects the application with the business account.
Authorised signatory information Establishes who can make the declaration.
Existing IEC and change details Defines an update rather than a new application.
Products and proposed trade activity Identifies adjacent permissions to examine.

Use the current DGFT checklist for the exact evidence and authentication method. Do not share passwords or OTPs through the website enquiry form.

sections.title: How the IEC assignment works
sections.html:
1. Establish the entity and application type

Confirm whether the business needs a new code or work on an existing record.

2. Reconcile the application information

Rapid helps organise consistent entity, address and bank records.

3. Complete the authorised submission

The applicant confirms the facts and official authentication. We coordinate the agreed application and query responses.

4. Keep the issued record current

Retain the code and plan the required confirmation or updates rather than treating the first certificate as the last action.

sections.title: Official fee, updates and timing
sections.html:
DGFT's manual lists ₹500 for a new IEC application. This is a government charge, separate from Rapid's fee. DGFT's fee schedule lists annual IEC updating during April–June without a fee under the stated provision; other updates or delays should be checked against the current schedule. DGFT fee schedule.

The timetable depends on accurate records, authentication and any queries. We do not promise shipment clearance as an outcome of obtaining IEC.

sections.title: Questions about IEC
sections.html:
Is IEC a product licence? No. Product-specific restrictions and approvals need separate attention.

Do I need another IEC for a changed address? First review the existing code and DGFT update route rather than assuming a new code is needed.

Can I ignore annual confirmation if nothing changed? Check the DGFT confirmation/update requirement even when particulars remain unchanged.

Does Rapid handle customs clearance? This page concerns IEC preparation and coordination. Any additional trade service must be separately defined.

title: FSSAI Registration & License for State & Centre
h1: FSSAI Registration and Licence Support in Haryana
description: Understand 2026 FSSAI registration and licence routes, documents, fees and validity. Rapid coordinates food-business applications in Haryana.
metaTitle: FSSAI Licence Haryana: Eligibility & Application | Rapid
introHtml:
Choose the food-business registration or licence that fits your operation. Rapid helps processors, storage businesses and other food enterprises organise their application, premises records and follow-ups through the relevant FSSAI route.

Start with what you make, store or sell, where the activity happens and its scale. We connect those facts to the correct application rather than choosing a licence only from a familiar turnover figure.

sections.title: What is FSSAI registration or licensing?
sections.html:
FSSAI regulates food businesses through registration and licensing under the food-safety framework. Applications are handled through FoSCoS, with the applicable route determined by the business category and current criteria. Official application portal.

The requirement concerns the food-business activity. It does not replace land-use permission, building approval or pollution consent where those apply.

sections.title: Registration, State licence or Central licence?
sections.html:
The turnover thresholds changed from 1 April 2026:

General turnover band Published route
Up to ₹1.5 crore Registration.
Above ₹1.5 crore and up to ₹50 crore State licence.
Above ₹50 crore Central licence.

These replace the older turnover bands. FSSAI order dated 13 March 2026.

The kind of business still matters. The revised eligibility table separately lists categories such as importers with Central licensing irrespective of turnover. Use the current category table for your activity rather than applying the general bands blindly. FoSCoS eligibility and fee table.

sections.title: What should your application explain?
sections.html:
The food activity and products

A mill, oil processor, cold store and importer perform different activities. List what the premises actually does and the products involved.

The premises and operating arrangement

Identify who runs the business, whether the premises is owned or leased, and what other activities happen there. A brand owner and a manufacturer may have different responsibilities.

The food-safety preparation

Bring the hygiene, layout, water and process information required for the particular application. The evidence should describe working arrangements at the premises.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid identifies the application category with your team, prepares the document checklist and coordinates the business and premises records. We follow the agreed application and help organise responses to queries or observations.

The food-business operator confirms the information and maintains food-safety practices. Testing and professional reports come from the responsible providers. FSSAI or the designated licensing authority makes the registration/licensing decision.

sections.title: Documents and details to prepare
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Entity and authorised-person details Identifies the applicant.
Premises address and possession evidence Connects the licence to the operating site.
Kind of business, products and turnover Helps select the applicable route.
Layout, equipment and capacity where relevant Explains the activity and scale.
Required food-safety, water or technical records Supports category-specific preparation.
Existing licence and proposed changes Establishes whether modification or another action is needed.

The exact FoSCoS checklist depends on the selected kind of business. Bring the available records first; the consultant explains which missing inputs are necessary.

sections.title: How the FSSAI assignment works
sections.html:
1. Identify the category and premises

Review the activity, scale, location and existing licence position.

2. Prepare the application evidence

Rapid coordinates the documents and professional inputs required for the chosen route.

3. Track submission and observations

The operator confirms the facts. We follow up and coordinate responses to the agreed file.

4. Keep the operating record current

Retain the issued document and address material changes in activities or particulars through the applicable process.

sections.title: Fees, validity and timing
sections.html:
The revised FoSCoS table labels fees per annum and lists ₹100 for registration, with licence charges dependent on the category, including ₹7,500 for Central licensing. Confirm the current payment requirements for the selected service on the portal. Rapid's fee, testing and premises improvements are separate.

The 2026 reform introduces perpetual validity subject to the applicable framework and risk-based inspections. This does not remove food-safety duties or the need to keep material particulars current. Existing-record transition and payment requirements should be checked on FoSCoS. FSSAI reform notice.

Preparation and any inspection/query process affect the timeline. Do not rely on a universal same-day licence promise for every food-business category.

sections.title: Questions food-business owners ask
sections.html:
Our turnover is below ₹1.5 crore. Is registration always enough? Check the kind of business as well. Special categories can require a different route.

We already have a licence. Should we apply again? Review the existing record, changes and current transition instructions before starting a fresh application.

Can a leased premises be considered? Bring the lease and operator details so possession and responsibility are correctly recorded.

Does FSSAI cover pollution consent? No. CTE and other site or operating requirements have their own applicability.

Can you help with queries? Yes. Share the submitted application and exact observations so we can scope the response work.

title: LEI Registration
h1: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) Registration Support
description: Understand Legal Entity Identifier registration, renewal and records. Rapid coordinates LEI applications with the appropriate issuing organisation.
metaTitle: LEI Registration & Renewal Support | Rapid Consulting
introHtml:
Keep an entity-identification requirement from holding up a banking or financial transaction. Rapid helps organise the legal-entity records and coordinate the agreed LEI registration or renewal work with the appropriate issuing organisation.

Start with the entity named in the transaction and the reason the bank or counterparty has requested an LEI. The code must identify that entity accurately.

sections.title: What is an LEI?
sections.html:
A Legal Entity Identifier is a 20-character identifier linked to reference information about a legal entity. It helps identify counterparties in financial transactions. LEIs are issued through the recognised issuing organisations in the global system, not by a consultancy simply creating a number. GLEIF: obtaining an LEI.

A requirement to hold an LEI depends on the applicable transaction or regulatory rule. Ask the requesting bank to identify the entity and requirement instead of assuming every business needs one for every loan.

sections.title: New registration, renewal or transfer?
sections.html:
Situation Work to consider
Entity has no LEI New registration through an eligible issuer.
Existing record is due for renewal Validate and update the reference information.
Name or corporate details changed Modification with supporting evidence.
Moving to another issuer Transfer of the existing LEI, not creation of a second identity.

Check for an existing code before applying. GLEIF's system supports public verification of entity information and status.

sections.title: Why accurate LEI records matter
sections.html:
Match the bank's counterparty

The borrowing or transacting entity may differ from a group company or trading name. Resolve that distinction before submitting the application.

Keep the status usable

Issuance is not the only action. Timely renewal and updates keep reference information current for the processes that rely on it.

Avoid contradictory corporate records

Name changes, legal form and ownership information should be supported by the right documents rather than informal explanations.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid prepares a document checklist, helps reconcile the legal-entity information and coordinates the agreed application or renewal. We track issuer queries and help organise the applicant's responses.

The entity's authorised representative confirms declarations and supporting facts. The issuing organisation validates the record and issues or renews the LEI. Rapid is not the issuer.

sections.title: Information to prepare
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Legal name, constitution and registration records Establishes the entity's identity.
Registered address and authorised-person information Supports the application and authority to act.
Existing LEI, if any Prevents duplicate registration.
Relevant ownership/parent-entity information Supports the reference-data questions where applicable.
Bank request or transaction context Explains which entity needs an active record and by when.

LEIL publishes application and renewal guidance for its process. LEIL FAQ.

sections.title: How the LEI assignment works
sections.html:
1. Identify the entity and existing record

Review the requesting bank's instruction and check whether an LEI is already held.

2. Assemble the legal-entity evidence

Rapid coordinates the required records and highlights inconsistencies.

3. Complete validation queries

Support the agreed issuer process using the applicant's confirmed information.

4. Retain the code and next renewal date

Keep the issued record and responsibility for future updates visible to the finance team.

sections.title: Fees, renewal and timing
sections.html:
Issuers publish their own registration and renewal charges, which may include multi-year payment options. A multi-year payment arrangement should not be confused with permission to leave the entity data unreviewed. Check the selected issuer's current terms and renewal requirements.

Rapid's coordination fee is separate. Timing depends on document consistency, issuer validation and responses to queries. A bank's transaction deadline does not guarantee an issuer will complete validation by that date.

sections.title: Questions about LEI
sections.html:
Can we use our parent company's LEI? The identifier must correspond to the relevant legal entity. Confirm the bank's requirement.

Does an LEI expire or need attention? Its reference data and registration status need renewal under the issuer's process. Track that obligation.

Do we get a new number on renewal? Renewal concerns the existing entity record, not a fresh duplicate identity.

Does LEI registration mean the loan is approved? No. Entity identification and credit sanction are separate processes.

title: Udyam Registration
h1: Udyam Registration and MSME Classification Guidance
description: Use the free official Udyam route and understand current MSME classification. Rapid explains how registration connects to your project requirements.
metaTitle: Udyam Registration & MSME Classification | Rapid
introHtml:
Understand your MSME registration and use the official, free Udyam route. Rapid helps business owners connect the enterprise's registration position with the investment, approval or funding work they are planning.

A correct registration record is a useful foundation. The next step is understanding which opportunities and requirements actually fit your business and project.

sections.title: What is Udyam registration?
sections.html:
Udyam is the Ministry of MSME's national registration system. Registration is free, online and based on self-declaration; the official system issues a permanent registration number and certificate. It does not require renewal. The Ministry directs applicants to its official portal and government facilitation channels. Official Udyam guidance.

Use the government Udyam portal for registration. Rapid is not the government portal and does not present this service as a paid substitute for the official process.

sections.title: Which MSME category applies?
sections.html:
The revised classification effective 1 April 2025 uses investment in plant and machinery/equipment and turnover together:

Category Investment ceiling Turnover ceiling
Micro ₹2.5 crore ₹10 crore
Small ₹25 crore ₹100 crore
Medium ₹125 crore ₹500 crore

Both criteria apply. Use the official rules for the calculation and classification, rather than comparing a total project budget with one column. Ministry classification table.

sections.title: What does registration help establish?
sections.html:
A recognised enterprise record

Keep the enterprise identity available for the business processes that request it. Ensure the entity in a project application is the same one shown in the relevant records.

A starting point for programme checks

A scheme or lending product may refer to MSME status. That makes the registration relevant, while the particular programme still has its own conditions.

Clearer planning as the business grows

A larger investment or changing turnover can affect classification. Keep the enterprise record connected to current financial information rather than relying on an old category label.

sections.title: What Udyam does not replace
sections.html:
Requirement Why it remains separate
Site and operating permissions Registration does not authorise every activity at every location.
Loan sanction A lender assesses repayment capacity and its product conditions.
Subsidy approval The programme determines eligible applicant, expenditure and dates.
HUM Haryana's state enterprise record has a different purpose.

See HUM guidance, Subsidies and Incentives and Finance for those next questions.

sections.title: What Rapid's guidance covers
sections.html:
We help identify how the enterprise's registration and project facts connect to a wider advisory requirement. For example, a machinery-expansion discussion needs to distinguish the registered enterprise from the new asset expenditure and production dates.

The official portal and government facilitation system remain the registration route. Any Rapid engagement concerns the separately agreed project or advisory work, with a stated fee and deliverable.

sections.title: Information for a useful discussion
sections.html:
Bring the existing certificate if available, the enterprise name and activity, the specific scheme or finance question, proposed investment details and the request that prompted the registration enquiry. Your CA can help explain financial figures and classification inputs.

There is no need to submit Aadhaar numbers, passwords or OTPs in the public enquiry form.

sections.title: How to take the next step
sections.html:
1. Check the official registration position

Use the government portal and existing certificate to establish the enterprise record.

2. Identify the business objective

Explain whether the need concerns a subsidy, finance, certification or another project requirement.

3. Scope the separate advisory work

Rapid explains the evidence and coordination needed for that objective, without treating registration as automatic eligibility.

sections.title: Questions about Udyam
sections.html:
Is there a government registration fee? The official Udyam registration is free. Be clear about the identity of the portal you use.

Do I renew the certificate every year? The official guidance says registration does not need renewal. Required enterprise information and updates remain a separate matter.

Is the investment ceiling the value of land and the entire project? The classification refers to the prescribed plant/machinery or equipment measure. Use the official calculation rules and your financial records.

Does Udyam guarantee a collateral-free loan? No. It does not replace the lender's credit assessment or scheme conditions.

Can an existing business discuss subsidies? Yes. Share the actual investment and dates; the answer depends on the relevant programme, not simply whether the business is new.

sections.title: What does industrial insurance mean?
sections.html:
Industrial insurance is a broad description of cover for business assets and related risks. The relevant products can address property damage, machinery, goods movement or liability, with separate terms and exclusions. It is not one universal policy covering every loss.

IRDAI's consumer information explains the range of general-insurance cover and the importance of appropriate asset values. The actual policy wording, schedule and endorsements determine a particular contract. IRDAI general-insurance guidance.

sections.title: Which risks should be discussed?

Goods in transit Which journeys, goods and transit conditions apply?
Interruption after a loss Is loss-of-profit/business-interruption cover required and provided?
Liability to others What liability cover fits the operation?

This table identifies review topics, not included cover. A policy called “comprehensive” still needs its actual wording examined.

sections.title: What a better insurance brief helps you do
sections.html:
Describe the facility accurately

Identify processes, storage, occupancy and neighbouring exposures. The insurer should receive the information it needs to assess the actual risk.

Compare equivalent proposals

Compare sums insured, deductibles, exclusions and conditions before choosing only on premium. Two prices may describe materially different protection.

Keep changes visible at renewal

New equipment, higher stock or an additional premises should not disappear from the insurance discussion simply because last year's schedule is convenient to reuse.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers

sections.title: What does claim-management support involve?
sections.html:
Claim support brings the policy, incident and loss evidence into a clear record. It helps the policyholder respond to requests and track outstanding actions. It does not replace the insurer's decision or the role of an appointed surveyor/loss assessor.

sections.title: What should happen after a loss?

Insurer notification Follow the policy's reporting process and retain acknowledgement.
Evidence Keep photographs, incident details and relevant records where safe.
Survey and document requests Maintain a list of requested, supplied and outstanding items.
Repairs or disposal Coordinate with the insurer/surveyor's requirements before evidence is lost.

The exact process depends on the policy and incident. IRDAI's general-insurance material explains claims and the role of salvage; the policy and insurer's instructions remain the specific reference. IRDAI non-life guidance.

sections.title: What organised support can improve

One reliable incident record

Bring the date, location, sequence and affected assets together. Avoid different versions of the incident being sent from different departments.

Evidence behind the loss calculation

Connect the claimed items with invoices, stock records, repair estimates and other relevant support. Identify estimates as estimates.

Clear follow-up ownership

Track who is supplying the next document and what the insurer is awaiting. This makes delays easier to address than an informal chain of calls.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers

introHtml:
Understand what your land could support before committing to a development model. Rapid brings the planning position, access, project concept and commercial assumptions together so you can compare realistic options and define the next professional work.

Whether you are considering a factory, warehouse or commercial development, the aim is a better investment decision: what can be pursued, what must be established and what each option would require.

sections.title: What does land-planning advisory cover?
sections.html:
The work examines the relationship between a parcel and a proposed use. It can include an initial planning review, coordination of site information and comparison of development assumptions. It does not replace a legal title opinion, certified valuation or detailed engineering design.

Haryana's TCP Department publishes development plans, controlled-area information and policies. These are starting records for the site-specific planning review. Official planning records.

sections.title: Which decision are you trying to make?
sections.html:
Decision Useful comparison
Buy or reject a site Intended use, access, records and unresolved constraints.
Develop, lease or retain land Cost, timing, income assumptions and management commitment.
Choose between factory, warehouse or commercial use Applicable planning route and the demands of each model.
Phase a larger parcel Infrastructure needs, cash commitments and delivery sequence.

An indicative option is not an approved entitlement. Keep market assumptions separate from verified planning facts.

sections.title: What a useful review brings into focus
sections.html:
The buildable and usable proposition

Gross area alone does not explain the development. Access, site shape, levels, common works and planning controls can affect the usable proposal.

The real cost of the option

Compare land, approval, infrastructure, building and financing assumptions together. A higher projected sale value may require substantially more capital and time.

The next decision and its evidence

Identify which survey, legal check, drawing or authority clarification will resolve the important unknown. The output should support a decision rather than simply describe the land.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid coordinates a site-and-objective brief, a record of known facts and assumptions, and an option/action summary for the agreed review. We identify the professional inputs required and connect the chosen path to the relevant approval or financing workstreams.

Your legal adviser owns title due diligence; planners and engineers own technical design; valuers own formal valuations. Rapid's coordination helps these inputs inform the same development decision.

h1: Business Loan Balance Transfer and Top-Up Support
description: Compare transfer savings, repayment terms and top-up funding. Rapid supports business-loan documentation, lender queries and closing coordination.
metaTitle: Business Loan Balance Transfer & Top-Up | Rapid
introHtml:
Make your existing borrowing work better for the business. Rapid helps you compare a balance transfer and any additional funding on the full cost, repayment schedule and practical conditions, then coordinates the agreed lender application.

Whether the objective is a lower borrowing cost, more suitable repayments or funds for an expansion, we turn the enquiry into a documented comparison you can use to decide.

sections.title: What are balance transfer and top-up?
sections.html:
A balance transfer refinances an existing loan with another lender. A top-up adds borrowing for a permitted purpose. They can be considered together, but approval of one does not automatically approve the other.

If you want the existing lender to revise your rate without transferring the loan, see Interest-Rate Reduction.

sections.title: Which option fits your objective?
sections.html:
Objective Option to examine
Lower the cost of current debt Existing-lender repricing versus a transfer.
Reduce the monthly payment Rate, remaining term and repayment-profile comparison.
Raise additional funds A top-up or separate facility matched to the use of funds.
Consolidate obligations Full cash-flow and security review, not only one lower EMI.

A longer repayment period can reduce the instalment while increasing total interest. The owner should see both effects before deciding.

sections.title: What a useful comparison should show
sections.html:
The cost of staying

Use the outstanding balance, current rate, reset terms and remaining schedule to establish the existing position.

The cost of moving

Include the proposed interest, processing and applicable closure charges, legal/valuation work and security-related costs. Confirm any prepayment charge against the actual contract and current applicable rules.

The effect of extra borrowing

Show the top-up separately so an increase in total debt is not mistaken for a saving on the old loan.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid organises a comparison of available written terms, a loan-document checklist and the agreed application file. We coordinate lender questions and track the conditions needed before closure or disbursement.

The lender assesses credit and sets terms. The borrower approves the application and decides whether the obligations fit the business. Valuation, title and legal work remain with the appointed professionals.

sections.title: Documents to prepare
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Current sanction, agreement and statement Establishes terms and outstanding debt.
Repayment schedule and payment history Shows the remaining cost and conduct.
Closure quote and proposed new offer Makes transfer costs and conditions comparable.
Financials, bank statements and other loans Supports the repayment case.
Top-up purpose and cost evidence Separates new borrowing from refinancing.
Security records Identifies release and fresh-security dependencies.

For applicable loans, ask for the lender's Key Facts Statement, including the all-in cost information. RBI explanation of KFS.

sections.title: How the financing assignment works
sections.html:
1. Define the objective and current cost

Rapid reviews the existing facility and the outcome you want.

2. Compare documented options

Evaluate the available terms on a consistent amount, tenure and cost basis, separating any top-up.

3. Coordinate the chosen application

With your authorisation, organise documents and lender responses.

4. Track sanction and transfer conditions

Coordinate the agreed closure, security and disbursement inputs. Sanction is not the same as funds being released.

sections.title: Fees, savings and timing
sections.html: Rapid's fee is separate from lender and third-party charges. A proposed saving should show the calculation and assumptions; it is not established by a headline rate. Preparation, credit review and security release can each affect timing.

Is a lower EMI always better? It may improve monthly liquidity but cost more over a longer term. Compare both the repayment and total cost.

Should I close the old loan immediately after sanction? Review the new conditions and coordinated closure process first; avoid a funding gap.

title: Collateral Free Loans
h1: Collateral-Free Business Loan Support
description: Understand collateral-free loans, CGTMSE, costs and repayment evidence. Rapid coordinates business-finance applications and lender queries.
metaTitle: Collateral-Free Business Loan Support Haryana | Rapid
introHtml:
Build a financing application around the strength of your business and the use of funds. Rapid helps Haryana enterprises examine collateral-free borrowing routes, prepare the repayment case and coordinate the agreed lender application.

Start with what the money will do: buy equipment, support stock or fund a new facility. The appropriate credit structure follows the need and the lender's assessment.

sections.title: What does collateral-free mean?
sections.html:
Collateral-free lending generally concerns the absence of additional collateral under the relevant product or scheme. It does not mean interest-free funding, no repayment obligation or no assessment of the business.

CGTMSE distinguishes primary security in the business/financed assets from additional collateral and explains the treatment of guarantees. The proposed sanction should state the actual obligations. CGTMSE security guidance.

sections.title: How does CGTMSE fit?
sections.html:
CGTMSE provides guarantee cover to eligible lending institutions for qualifying credit to micro and small enterprises. It is not a direct loan application to the Trust. The published framework supports eligible credit up to ₹10 crore from 1 April 2025, subject to its conditions. Ministry overview.

A scheme ceiling is not an amount every applicant can borrow. The lender must approve the credit case. CGTMSE also describes a hybrid-security option, so the exact covered and secured portions should be understood. Credit-facility parameters.

sections.title: What strengthens the application?
sections.html:
A specific funding purpose

Show the cost and business role of the equipment, stock or project being financed. A round-number request without a use-of-funds explanation is difficult to evaluate.

A credible repayment basis

Connect projected sales, margins and collection times with the repayment schedule. New businesses should identify assumptions; operating businesses should reconcile forecasts with their records.

A clear view of existing obligations

Include current loans and other commitments. A financing proposal needs to show the complete repayment burden.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid prepares the funding brief, coordinates the document set and helps structure the business and cash-flow explanation. We support the agreed lender approach, track queries and organise the outstanding sanction or disbursement inputs.

The lender decides eligibility, security, pricing and amount. Rapid is neither the lender nor the guarantor and does not promise approval because Udyam or a guarantee scheme is available.

sections.title: Documents to bring
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Entity, activity and registration records Identifies the borrower.
Financial statements, tax records and bank statements Shows performance and cash movement.
Existing loans and repayment history Establishes current obligations.
Quotations or use-of-funds breakdown Supports the requested amount.
Cash-flow assumptions and own contribution Explains how the requirement will be funded and repaid.

sections.title: How the loan-support assignment works
sections.html:
1. Match the purpose to a facility

Identify whether the need is term finance, working capital or another product.

2. Prepare the business case

Rapid coordinates the evidence and highlights gaps with your finance team.

3. Support the authorised lender application

Organise the agreed submission and responses to credit questions.

4. Review the offer and outstanding conditions

Help make the repayment, charges and obligations visible before you accept the facility.

sections.title: Costs and expected timeline
sections.html:
Separate interest, lender processing charges, any applicable guarantee fee, professional costs and Rapid's fee. “Collateral-free” does not mean cost-free. A guarantee mechanism also does not remove lender scrutiny or document requirements.

Timing depends on the borrower, facility and credit assessment. We define the preparation work after reviewing your available records.

sections.html:
Can a new business be considered? It can be examined under the relevant product, but projections and promoter capability need a credible basis.

sections.html:
This service concerns financing preparation for a business project, such as a new plant, building or substantial expansion. Land, building and machinery Which costs are included in the proposed long-term funding?

sections.title: What lenders need to understand
sections.html:
A complete project cost

Bring construction, equipment, installation and other relevant costs into a consistent schedule. Separate quotations from amounts already paid.

The promoter's contribution

Explain the funds committed by the owners and when they are available. The proposed debt amount must connect to the remaining requirement.

A realistic operating forecast

Show capacity use, prices, costs, margins and collection assumptions. A forecast is more useful when the lender can understand what changes if production ramps up slowly.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid organises the project brief, cost and funding information, supporting-document checklist and the agreed application package. We coordinate with your CA, equipment suppliers and project team to close information gaps, then follow up on lender questions.

Your management approves business assumptions and factual statements. Formal valuation, technical appraisal and financial certification retain their professional owners. The lender determines the structure, sanction and disbursement.

sections.title: Documents to prepare

Stage Funding question

sections.title: What strengthens the proposal?
sections.html:
A realistic cost to complete

Separate expenditure already paid from commitments and remaining works. A historical total cost does not show how much funding is still needed.

Evidence behind receipts

Distinguish completed collections, documented bookings or leases and projected sales. The lender needs to see which cash flows are established and which are assumptions.

Consistent approvals and project identity

Land, licence, building and relevant registration records should describe the same project and promoter. Haryana RERA publishes the project-registration framework. Its applicability is a separate legal workstream. Haryana RERA regulations.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid coordinates the funding brief, cost-to-complete inputs, document checklist and agreed application package. We work with the promoter's finance, planning and legal teams to organise responses and track lender conditions.

Formal title, valuation, technical appraisal and legal compliance remain with their responsible professionals. The lender determines credit and disbursement. Rapid does not provide a merchant-banking, securities-placement or guaranteed-finance service through this page.

sections.title: Documents to prepare

Bring Why it matters
Promoter/entity records and project structure Identifies borrower and responsibility.

Can expected sales be shown as confirmed receipts? No. Keep projections, bookings and collections distinct.

h1: Equipment Loan Support for Industrial Businesses
description: Prepare a machinery-finance application with clear costs, contribution and repayment evidence. Rapid coordinates lender documents and follow-ups.
metaTitle: Equipment & Machinery Loan Support | Rapid Consulting
introHtml:
Fund the machine your business needs with a proposal built around its cost, installation and earning role. Rapid helps organise equipment-finance records, compare available terms and coordinate the agreed lender application.

Whether you are replacing a machine or adding capacity, we connect the purchase with the business's cash flow and the funds needed to put the equipment to work.

sections.title: What can an equipment-finance proposal include?
sections.html:
Equipment finance supports an eligible machinery purchase under the lender's product. The lender determines which costs, equipment and borrowers it will consider. New and used machinery, imported equipment and specialised installations may have different requirements.

The equipment price and the total project cost are not always the same. Freight, duties, foundations, installation and working capital should be identified even where a lender will not fund every item.

sections.title: Which costs belong in the plan?
sections.html:
Cost or need What to clarify
Machine quotation Specifications, taxes and supplier payment schedule.
Installation and site preparation Who funds the work needed before production.
Own contribution Amount and timing of the borrower's funds.
Additional raw material and labour Operating cash needed after commissioning.
Insurance and security The lender's conditions and asset-protection arrangements.

sections.title: What makes the application stronger?
sections.html:
Explain the machine's business purpose

Show whether it adds capacity, improves quality, replaces unreliable equipment or serves a confirmed requirement. The lender needs more than the model number.

Connect delivery with repayment

Account for the time between supplier payment, installation and productive use. Ask how the proposed repayment schedule fits that sequence.

Make the existing business position clear

Bring operating results and current obligations together. A useful proposal shows the effect of the new loan on the complete business.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid organises the equipment and funding brief, document checklist and agreed lender submission. We coordinate quotation clarifications, financial inputs and query responses, then track outstanding sanction/disbursement records within scope.

The supplier owns its equipment specification and delivery commitments. The borrower approves the purchase and loan; the lender determines eligibility, margin, pricing and security. Rapid does not guarantee supplier performance or loan approval.

sections.title: Documents to prepare
sections.html:
Bring the supplier quotation, equipment specifications, delivery/payment terms, business financials and bank statements, existing borrowing, site and relevant approval information, and the proposed contribution. For used equipment, identify age, ownership and the valuation information available.

Input Why it matters
Output/capacity change Explains the operating benefit.
Installation cost and schedule Shows the full funds and time required.
Forecast or order evidence Supports the repayment case.
Existing equipment loans Shows the obligations already attached to the business.

sections.title: How the equipment-finance assignment works

1. Define the purchase and total requirement

2. Prepare the application evidence

3. Compare and pursue the selected offer

Can the whole purchase be financed? The lender decides margin and eligible costs. Identify your contribution before committing to supplier payments.

Does sanction mean the supplier has been paid? No. Disbursement follows the applicable conditions and release process.

Can we consider subsidy alongside the loan? Yes, through a separate eligibility review. Discuss expenditure dates before assuming the same asset qualifies for assistance.

title: Working Capital Finance
h1: Working Capital Finance Support
description: Plan cash-credit, overdraft or operating-finance requirements around stock and receivables. Rapid supports lender applications and facility reviews.
metaTitle: Working Capital Finance Support Haryana | Rapid
introHtml:
Keep your funding aligned with the way money moves through the business. Rapid helps you explain the gap between paying for stock and collecting from customers, choose the facility to examine and coordinate the agreed lender application.

For a mill buying seasonal raw material, a manufacturer waiting on customer payments or a distributor building stock, the right discussion starts with the operating cycle rather than a round-number loan request.

sections.title: What is working capital finance?
sections.html:
Working capital supports operating needs such as inventory, production and receivables. It differs from long-term funding for a building or machine. Banks offer structures including cash credit, overdrafts, demand loans and bill-based facilities, depending on the business and product. SBI working-capital explanation.

This is a description of facility types, not a recommendation of one lender or a promise of its terms.

sections.title: Which facility should be examined?
sections.html:
Need Type of discussion
Recurring stock and receivables gap Cash-credit or overdraft structure.
A defined seasonal requirement Time-bound operating finance.
Documented sales awaiting payment Bill/invoice financing where suitable.
A long-lived machine or building Equipment or project finance, rather than consuming operating liquidity.

The lender determines the available product, eligible assets and limits. A sanction amount and the amount currently drawable can differ under the facility's conditions.

sections.title: What makes the funding calculation useful?
sections.html:
Map the cash cycle

Show how long stock is held, when suppliers are paid and when customers pay. The funding gap sits between those events.

Make seasonality visible

A grain processor's peak stock requirement may differ sharply from an average month. Explain the peak and how the borrowing reduces after collections.

Reconcile records with the request

Stock statements, debtor ageing, turnover and bank movements should tell a consistent story. Identify slow-moving inventory and overdue receivables rather than treating them as immediately collectible cash.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid prepares the funding brief and document checklist, coordinates the operating and financial evidence and supports the agreed lender application. We follow up on questions and help make reporting, renewal and sanction conditions visible to your finance team.

Management owns forecasts and stock/debtor declarations. The lender assesses limits, drawing conditions, security and price. Rapid does not certify inventory or guarantee customer collections.

sections.title: Documents to bring
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Financial statements and tax records Establishes the operating history.
Bank statements and existing facilities Shows cash movement and current borrowing.
Stock, receivables and creditor ageing Explains funds tied up in the cycle.
Monthly sales and purchase pattern Identifies seasonality and peak demand.
Forecast, orders and customer terms Supports the proposed requirement.
Current sanction and reporting conditions Shows what a renewal or enhancement must address.

sections.title: How the working-capital assignment works
sections.html:
1. Understand the operating gap

Rapid reviews the timing of purchases, production and collections.

2. Prepare the facility case

Coordinate the records and explain the amount and period of funding required.

3. Support the lender discussion

Organise the authorised application and responses to the credit assessment.

4. Track conditions and review dates

Help the team identify the documents and ongoing reporting required by the agreed facility.

sections.title: Costs, renewal and timing
sections.html:
Compare interest on the relevant utilisation basis, processing/renewal charges and other applicable costs. The sanction should explain reporting, drawing-power and review requirements. Rapid's fee is separate.

An enhancement or renewal can require updated performance and stock/debtor records. Start before a review date becomes an urgent operating problem. The lender controls approval and availability of funds.

sections.title: Questions about working capital
sections.html:
Is the sanctioned limit always available to draw? The facility's drawing-power and other conditions can limit current availability.

Can I use working capital to buy a building? The permitted end use governs the facility. Discuss a suitable long-term structure instead of assuming operating finance can fund it.

Can a seasonal business be considered? Yes, the application should explain its seasonal peak and repayment cycle; the lender decides suitability.

Will higher turnover automatically increase the limit? The lender assesses the complete requirement and credit position, not one figure alone.

title: Business Loan Interest-Rate Reduction
h1: Business Loan Interest-Rate Reduction
description: Review repricing of an existing business loan. Rapid coordinates current terms, a supported lender request and the net effect of any revised offer.
metaTitle: Business Loan Interest-Rate Reduction | Rapid
introHtml:
Review whether your existing business loan can be repriced on a better basis. Rapid helps you understand the current interest terms, prepare a documented request and coordinate the agreed discussion with your lender.

The objective is a lower borrowing cost where the evidence and lender terms support it. Start with the current facility before assuming that moving the entire loan is the only option.

sections.title: What does interest-rate reduction involve?
sections.html:
Interest-rate reduction means seeking a revision to the pricing of an existing loan. It can involve understanding the benchmark, the spread charged above it, reset terms and the lender's repricing policy.

This service was previously labelled “ROI Deduction”. Here ROI means rate of interest. It is not a tax-deduction service or a guarantee of improved investment returns.

sections.title: Repricing, reset or balance transfer?
sections.html:
Situation What to examine
Benchmark-linked rate changes Contractual reset timing and how the applicable benchmark is reflected.
Request for a lower spread or revised pricing The lender's review/conversion process and supporting credit case.
Alternative lender offers better terms Full balance-transfer comparison, including costs.
Need for additional borrowing A separate top-up or facility assessment.

A lower rate offered to a new borrower does not establish that the same price automatically applies to an existing contract.

sections.title: What a useful rate review should show
sections.html:
The actual current pricing

Bring the sanction, latest statement and rate-change communications together. Identify whether the facility is fixed or floating and what the contract says about resets.

The net benefit after charges

A conversion or repricing fee can reduce the benefit. Compare the remaining repayment cash flows, not just the first month's interest difference.

The credit case for the request

Updated performance and repayment conduct may help explain the request. The lender decides how these affect its pricing; improved numbers are not an automatic entitlement to a quoted reduction.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid prepares a current-terms summary, coordinates the records for the repricing request and compares any written proposal against the existing arrangement. We follow up on the agreed lender discussion and help you understand the change before accepting it.

The borrower authorises the request. The lender decides the revised rate, conditions and effective date. Rapid does not amend the loan agreement or promise a percentage reduction on the lender's behalf.

sections.title: Documents to prepare
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Sanction and loan agreement Establishes benchmark, spread and contractual terms.
Latest statement and repayment schedule Shows balance and remaining cost.
Recent rate/reset communications Explains how current pricing was reached.
Updated financials and repayment record Supports the business case for review.
Alternative offer, if any Provides a documented comparison.
Proposed conversion/repricing charge Allows a net-benefit calculation.

For applicable loans, use the lender's Key Facts Statement to compare the important cost information. RBI KFS explanation.

sections.title: How the rate-review assignment works
sections.html:
1. Establish the existing terms

Rapid reviews the facility records and the outcome you want.

2. Prepare a supported request

Coordinate the updated business evidence and identify the specific pricing change being sought.

3. Follow the lender's response

Track the agreed discussion and obtain the proposed terms in writing.

4. Compare and confirm the effect

Show the rate, effective date, fees and repayment effect so you can decide whether to accept. Keep the lender's final confirmation with the loan records.

sections.title: Fees, savings and timing
sections.html:
Rapid's fee and any lender conversion charge are separate. A projected saving depends on the outstanding balance, future rates, repayment pattern and remaining term. State those assumptions rather than presenting an estimate as money already saved.

The lender's review process controls the decision and date. If repricing is unsuitable, a transfer can be examined separately without treating it as an automatic next action.

sections.title: Questions about rate reduction
sections.html:
Will an RBI rate cut immediately reduce my instalment? It depends on the facility's benchmark, reset and contractual terms. Review the actual agreement and lender communication.

Can I keep the same lender? Yes, this service starts with reviewing repricing of the existing facility.

Is the lowest rate always the best option? Compare charges, tenure and other conditions as well as the rate.

Can you guarantee a reduction? No. Rapid prepares and coordinates the request; the lender controls the outcome.

title: Preparing for a manufacturing-subsidy discussion
h1: What should you prepare before discussing a manufacturing subsidy?
description: Bring your activity, investment, site details and dates into one useful brief before discussing a manufacturing subsidy or incentive application.
metaTitle: Prepare for a Manufacturing Subsidy Discussion | Rapid Consulting
introHtml:
Start with a short project brief: what the business does, where the investment is being made, what you are spending on and which commitments have already happened. Then bring the records available to support that account.

You do not need a finished application file to have a useful first conversation. The purpose is to give the adviser a clear picture of the investment so the relevant programme and next step can be examined.

sections.title: Describe the activity in plain language
sections.html:
Explain what the unit makes or processes, the main raw material and the output. If the investment is an expansion, describe the existing operation and what will change.

“Adding a production line at our existing unit” is a useful start. Add the type of line and how it changes the operation. “We need an MSME subsidy” identifies a broad interest but says little about the project behind it.

For an equipment purchase, explain what the machine does. A testing instrument, a production machine and a safety installation have different purposes. The purpose should be clear before the programme is discussed.

sections.title: Identify the business making the investment
sections.html:
Keep the applicant business name and constitution available. If more than one entity or site is involved, explain which one holds the assets and which one is making the application.

A group turnover figure does not replace the records for the unit seeking assistance. Similarly, an owner's personal investment plan and expenditure already recorded in the business should not be presented as the same thing.

You can raise any uncertainty in the discussion. The important point is to identify it rather than fill the gap with an assumption.

sections.title: Separate the expenditure categories
sections.html:
A single total can hide the parts that need to be examined. Put machinery, building, land and other costs in separate lines, using the records available.

Cost or figure How to describe it
Proposed machinery Quotation value and whether an order has been placed
Purchased equipment Invoice value, purchase date and payment position
Building work Recorded or proposed expenditure and construction stage
Land or lease The arrangement and available documents
Total project budget The categories included in the total
Company turnover A separate business measure, with the relevant period

Do not call every cost an eligible cost before the programme conditions have been examined. Keeping the categories separate makes that review easier.

sections.title: Make a simple timeline
sections.html:
Write down the dates you know: order, invoice, payment, start of construction, installation and commercial production. Mark planned dates as planned and actual dates as actual.

If an invoice has been issued but payment is incomplete, say so. If one part of an expansion is operating while another is still being installed, explain the difference.

A timeline helps the adviser compare the project with the relevant programme's conditions. It also stops the application from relying on a date that describes a different milestone.

sections.title: 5 Bring the site and existing records
sections.html:
Keep the district, site address and available ownership or lease information ready. Add the registrations, permissions and correspondence connected to the unit.

You are not being asked to obtain every possible approval before the first discussion. The adviser needs to understand the documented position and identify what the actual assignment requires.

If a document is held by your architect, CA or another colleague, note who has it. That is more useful than guessing its contents.

sections.title: 6. Include earlier assistance and applications
sections.html:
Tell the adviser about benefits already claimed or received and any application currently in progress. Bring the relevant references and communication if available.

Different programmes can treat overlapping assistance differently. The review needs the history of the particular investment and applicant, not just the scheme you are considering today.

If an earlier application has a query, keep the actual communication. A short verbal summary can leave out the detail that the next response needs to address.

sections.title: An example of a useful first brief
sections.html:
We operate a manufacturing unit in Haryana and are adding equipment at the same site. We have quotations for the new machines and invoices for part of the building work. One equipment order has been placed. Production on the new line has not started. Our CA holds the expenditure records, and our site consultant holds the land and approval documents. We want to understand the relevant incentive opportunity and the application work Rapid can manage.

This is an illustrative brief, not a client case or an eligibility statement. Its value is that it separates the activity, investment, stage and people holding the records.

sections.title: What happens in the first discussion?
sections.html:
Rapid uses the brief to understand the requirement and identify the information needed for the next step. A formal assessment, application or response assignment is then defined through its own scope.

You should understand which work Rapid will manage, which inputs your team supplies and what the next milestone means. Application, sanction and release of funds remain separate stages.

Read about subsidy advisory · See how we work

sections.title: Questions about preparation
sections.html:
I have already bought machinery. Is it too late to speak?

Share the actual dates and records. The conversation should start from your current position. Whether a programme remains relevant depends on its conditions and the facts of the investment.

Do I need a scheme name first?

No. Explain the project. Identifying relevant programme questions is part of the advisory discussion.

Should my CA join?

It can help if they hold the expenditure or company records. A plant or site colleague may be useful for technical information. Bring the people relevant to the questions being discussed.

sections.title: Turn your brief into the next step
sections.html:
Share the activity, district and investment you want to discuss. An expert consultant from Rapid will call you to understand the project and explain how we can take the advisory work forward.

h1: Food and Agro-Processing Project Support in Haryana
description: Plan a food-processing unit, mill expansion or equipment investment with coordinated subsidy, FSSAI, approval and finance support in Haryana.
metaTitle: Food & Agro-Processing Consultant Haryana | Rapid
introHtml:
Build or expand your processing business with coordinated subsidy, approval and funding support. Rapid takes ownership of the agreed advisory work, from understanding the investment to preparing applications and managing follow-ups.

Before construction or machinery commitments, establish the product and process, check the site and operating requirements, and examine the funding and incentive sequence. You can describe your mill or plant in familiar terms; we connect it to the services it needs.

sections.title: Support for the investment you have in mind
sections.html:
A new processing unit

You may be turning grain, oilseed or another agricultural input into a finished product. The plan needs to connect raw material, output, storage, utilities and the time required to start production.

Rapid brings the site, cost and process records into an approval and funding brief, identifies the relevant advisory work and coordinates the agreed applications with your CA and technical team.

Expansion of an operating mill or plant

A new line or building changes an existing business. Separate today's capacity and permissions from the proposed addition, including machinery orders and spending already made.

Rapid organises the investment trail, reviews relevant incentive questions and coordinates the selected approval or finance work around the change. Existing operations provide context, but do not automatically cover the expansion.

A targeted equipment requirement

Rapid connects the asset's purpose, quotation or invoice and expenditure dates to the relevant service. The proposal makes the narrower scope and deliverables clear.

sections.title: What should a food-project plan explain?
sections.html:
Project question Useful detail
What is being processed? Raw material, product and process flow.
What is the scale? Existing and proposed output with units, machine capacity and storage.
Where will it operate? Site, access, ownership/lease and available layout.
What utilities are needed? Water, fuel, power and relevant waste streams.
How will it earn and collect? Customers, seasonality, margins and collection assumptions.

sections.title: Start with the plant you intend to operate

A change in feedstock, process or capacity may go beyond the earlier permission. Keep the current authorised activity separate from the proposed change.

sections.title: The investment behind the assignment
sections.html:
The unit had recorded expenditure across plant and machinery and its building. Together, those categories amounted to approximately ₹49 lakh.

For the subsidy work, a total investment figure was only the starting point. The application also needed to be understood through the unit's business constitution, production date and site records. Each part explained a different aspect of the investment.

The scale shown here refers to the recorded machinery and building expenditure. It is not a statement of company turnover, complete project value or subsidy received.

sections.title: What Rapid took forward
sections.html:
Rapid's assessment brought the machinery and building figures together with the recorded commercial-production date, constitution and land-related information. That established the project context for the application work.

The assignment progressed through preparation of application documents, collection of signed copies and portal submission. It required coordination between the financial record of the investment and the unit's operating and site details.

A building cost, a machine cost and a land record are not interchangeable evidence. Keeping them distinct made the application about the actual project rather than a general claim that the business had invested money.

sections.title: The outcome
sections.html: The client received capital-subsidy support associated with the manufacturing investment. Rapid's contribution covered the assessment and application work connecting the expenditure and project records to the claim.

sections.title: What a similar business can take from this case
sections.html:
A useful subsidy assignment starts with a clear investment basis. Separate the categories, establish the dates and connect the spending to the unit making the application.

For a manufacturer planning an expansion, this is a reason to organise the new investment separately from the existing business. It gives the advisory work a defined project to examine and pursue.

title: Subsidies & Incentives
h1: Subsidies and Incentives Advisory in Haryana
description: Pursue the subsidy potential of your Haryana investment with scheme assessment, documentation, application and follow-up support from Rapid.
metaTitle: Subsidy Consultant in Haryana | Rapid Consulting

sections.title: Unlock the full subsidy potential of your next investment
sections.html:
From identifying relevant incentives to preparing applications and managing follow-ups, Rapid takes ownership of the work, helping your business pursue the full benefit its project qualifies for.

Whether you are building a first unit, expanding a plant or investing in specific equipment, we connect the opportunity, project records and application process around your business.

sections.title: What can subsidy advisory help you achieve?
sections.html:
Identify opportunities you may not know by name

Describe the unit and investment in familiar terms. Rapid examines relevant programmes and identifies the project facts that determine which opportunities deserve further work.

Plan commitments with the application in mind

Orders, payments, construction and production dates can matter. An early review lets the team consider the sequence before more commitments are fixed.

Carry a documented application forward

Bring the cost trail, required professional inputs and departmental responses into one coordinated file, with clear next actions.

sections.title: What kinds of benefit should you understand?
sections.html:
Benefit type What it generally addresses
Capital assistance A defined portion of eligible investment under a programme.
Interest support Specified borrowing-cost assistance, usually through a defined route and period.
Reimbursement Eligible expenditure supported by the required evidence and claim process.
Tax/duty-linked incentive A particular levy or payment subject to the programme's conditions.

These describe different mechanisms, not benefits available to every business. The scheme page owns its current rates, caps, dates and conditions. Explore the Scheme Directory.

sections.title: How do we establish which schemes fit?
sections.html:
A useful assessment connects the applicant, activity, location, expenditure and dates. It distinguishes a new unit from an expansion and a whole project from an individual eligible asset.

Official programme information changes. Haryana's MSME Directorate now lists 2026 policy material alongside earlier policies; a legacy scheme name alone does not establish the governing route for a new investment. Haryana policy directory. For food projects, the relevant MoFPI guidelines and amendments must be read with the applicable invitation and project facts.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Stage What you receive from the agreed assignment
Opportunity review A shortlist of relevant routes and the eligibility questions to settle.
Evidence preparation A project-specific checklist, cost/date record and outstanding-input list.
Application work Coordinated application material and a submission record.
Queries and follow-ups A record of observations, responses and next actions.
Later claim stages, if included Coordination of the particular evidence and follow-ups agreed for that stage.

We define which stages are included before work begins. Your business and CA confirm financial facts and certifications. The authority or lender decides eligibility, sanction and release.

sections.title: Information for a useful assessment
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Activity, entity and district Identifies the applicant and project setting.
Site and possession records Establishes where the investment is made.
Machinery, building and other costs separately Makes the eligible-cost question answerable.
Quotations, invoices and payments Distinguishes proposed and incurred expenditure.
Order, construction and production dates Shows the sequence against programme conditions.
Existing permissions and earlier assistance Identifies prerequisites and overlap questions.

You do not need a polished project report to make the first call. Bring the facts you have; we explain which further records the chosen assignment needs.

sections.title: How the work moves forward
sections.html:
1. Understand the investment

Establish the activity, scale, location and stage, including money already committed.

2. Review relevant opportunities

Identify the programme and evidence needed to assess fit, rather than treating the directory as an eligibility list.

3. Prepare and coordinate the application

Organise records and professional inputs, then track the agreed submission and responses.

4. Follow the relevant decision or claim stage

Keep the next action clear. Application, sanction and disbursement are different milestones and should be recorded separately.

sections.title: Fees and timing
sections.html: Rapid's fee depends on the programme, stage and agreed work. Official charges and professional certifications, where relevant, are identified separately. Preparation, authority review and later release can have different schedules. A subsidy should not be treated as cash already available to pay a supplier.

sections.title: See the work in a project context
sections.html:
A Hisar manufacturing assignment involved approximately ₹49 lakh in recorded machinery and building investment. Rapid brought the expenditure, production and site records together for the capital-subsidy application.

Read the manufacturing case

For a focused investment, see the Sirsa testing-equipment case. These figures describe investment, not the amount of subsidy received.

sections.title: Questions about subsidy advisory
sections.html:
Can you identify the scheme for us? Yes. Start with the business and investment; you do not need to know the programme name.

Can we apply after buying machinery? Share the actual dates. The particular programme determines whether and how the incurred expenditure can be considered.

Can different benefits be combined? The overlap and eligible expenditure need checking against each programme. Disclose previous assistance and live applications.

Will every rupee of project cost qualify? Not necessarily. Keep land, building, machinery and other costs separate for the relevant calculation.

Can our CA remain involved? Yes. We coordinate the agreed application around the people who own the financial and technical inputs.

sections.title: Which approvals belong to which stage?
sections.html:
Project stage Questions to resolve
Site selection Permitted use, ownership/control, access and any land restrictions.
Design and establishment Building, fire-scheme and applicable environmental permissions.
Completion and operation Occupation, fire and operating-consent requirements.
Expansion or renewal Which existing permissions need revision, renewal or a separate application?

This is a planning sequence, not a universal checklist. Haryana TCP and HSPCB publish separate procedures for their services. TCP service list · HSPCB services.

Rapid tracks agreed applications and identifies the record, drawing or response needed from each responsible person.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers

The assignment sets out the selected applications, document checklist, professional inputs and follow-up responsibilities. We maintain the submission and query record and coordinate responses through the agreed stages.

Architects, engineers, laboratories and legal advisers own their respective technical work. The applicant confirms facts and fulfils conditions; authorities decide permissions. The scope identifies additional work before it is undertaken.

sections.title: Documents to start with
